Element.Name: Specification identification
Element.Description: Identifies the specification of content and rules that apply to the transaction.

Element.Name: Business process type identifier
Element.Description: Identifies the BII profile or business process context in which the transaction appears.

Element.Name: Document identifier
Element.Description: An transaction instance must contain an identifier. The identifier enables positive referencing the document instance for various purposes including referencing between transactions that are part of the same process.

Element.Name: Dispatch advice issue date
Element.Description: The date when this version of the Manifest is issued. Format = "YYYY-MM-DD".

Element.Name: Dispatch advice issue time
Element.Description: The time when this version of the Manifest is issued. Format = "hh:mm:ss".

Element.Name: Manifest type code
Element.Description: A code signifying the type of Manifest, e.g. cargo manifest, crew list, passenger list or ship's/aircraft's stores declaration. Must be part of UNCL1001 (restricted to the subset relevant for Manifest - see structure/codelist/UNCL1001_T131.xml).

Element.Name: Manifest type
Element.Description: The type of Manifest expressed as free text, used when the type cannot be, or is not, expressed by ManifestTypeCode.

Element.Name: Version
Element.Description: The version of this Manifest. Used for maintaining updated versions of the same Manifest.

Element.Name: Ad valorem indicator
Element.Description: An indication that the goods declared in this Manifest are subject to an ad valorem duty, i.e. a duty calculated as a percentage of the declared value of the goods (true), or not (false).

Element.Name: Declared carriage value amount
Element.Description: The value of the goods declared for carriage. Used as the basis for calculating any ad valorem duty when AdValoremIndicator is true.

Element.Name: Sending Logistics Operator party
Element.Description: The party issuing the Manifest. Normally the Logistics Operator that operates, or arranges the operation of, the means of transport (vessel, aircraft, truck or wagon) that the Manifest describes.

Element.Name: Endpoint ID
Element.Description: An identifier for the end point of the routing service for the Sending Logistics Operator party (e.g., EAN Location Number, GLN).

Element.Name: Sending Logistics Operator identification
Element.Description: An identifier for the Sending Logistics Operator party.

Element.Name: ID
Element.Description: The ID used for identification.

Element.Name: Sending Logistics Operator party name
Element.Description: The name of the Sending Logistics Operator party.

Element.Name: Postal address
Element.Description: The postal address of the Sending Logistics Operator party.

Element.Name: Address line 1
Element.Description: The main address line in a postal address usually the street name and number.

Element.Name: Address line 2
Element.Description: An additional address line in a postal address that can be used to give further details supplementing the main line.

Element.Name: City
Element.Description: The common name of the city where the postal address is.

Element.Name: Post code
Element.Description: The identifier for an addressable group of properties according to the relevant national postal service.

Element.Name: Country subdivision
Element.Description: For specifying a region, county, state, province etc. within a country by using text.

Element.Name: Country
Element.Description: The country of the address

Element.Name: Country code
Element.Description: A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Element.Name: Sending Logistics Operator party name
Element.Description: The name of the Sending Logistics Operator party.

Element.Name: Sending Logistics Operator parties legal registration ID
Element.Description: The official identifier of the party as registered with the relevant fiscal authority.

Attribute.Name: Scheme identifier
Attribute.Description: The identification scheme identifier of the Sending Logistics Operator legal registration identifier

Element.Name: Contact
Element.Description: The contact of the Sending Logistics Operator party.

Element.Name: Contact name
Element.Description: The contact name.

Element.Name: Contact telephone number
Element.Description: The phone number of the contact.

Element.Name: Contact email address
Element.Description: The electronic mail of the contact.

Element.Name: Authority party
Element.Description: A public body (e.g. customs, port state control, terminal control) that requires this Manifest before, during or after a journey, in order to control cargo, crew and/or passengers.

Element.Name: Endpoint ID
Element.Description: An identifier for the end point of the routing service for the Authority party (e.g., EAN Location Number, GLN).

Element.Name: Authority party name
Element.Description: The name of the Authority party.

Element.Name: Postal address

Element.Name: Country

Element.Description: A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Element.Description: The phone number of the contact.

Element.Name: Contact email address

Element.Name: Consignor party name

Element.Name: Contact

Element.Description: The party to whom the goods described in the Manifest's shipment are addressed.

Element.Name: Crew Person
Element.Description: A crew member of the means of transport (vessel or aircraft) that the Manifest describes. Repeat for each crew member declared.

Element.Name: First name
Element.Description: The crew member's first name.

Element.Name: Family name
Element.Description: The crew member's family name.

Element.Name: Job title
Element.Description: The crew member's job title / function on board (e.g. Captain, First Officer, Purser).

Element.Name: Nationality code
Element.Description: A code that identifies the crew member's nationality, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Element.Name: Identity Document Reference
Element.Description: Reference to an identity document for the crew member, e.g. a passport or seaman's book.

Element.Name: ID
Element.Description: The ID of the identity document, for instance a passport number.

Element.Name: Document Type
Element.Description: The type of identity document.

Element.Name: Passenger Person
Element.Description: A passenger carried on the means of transport (vessel or aircraft) that the Manifest describes. Repeat for each passenger declared.

Element.Name: First name
Element.Description: The passenger's first name.

Element.Name: Family name
Element.Description: The passenger's family name.

Element.Name: Nationality code
Element.Description: A code that identifies the passenger's nationality, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Element.Name: Identity Document Reference
Element.Description: Reference to an identity document for the passenger, e.g. a passport.

Element.Name: ID
Element.Description: The ID of the identity document, for instance a passport number.

Element.Name: Document Type
Element.Description: The type of identity document.

Element.Name: Shipment
Element.Description: The shipment carried by the means of transport that this Manifest describes. Kept lean by design: the Manifest does not repeat the full goods-item level detail of the underlying Waybill, it summarizes the consignment and refers to the Waybill for full detail (see cac:DocumentReference below).

Element.Name: Shipment identifier
Element.Description: Identifies the shipment described by this Manifest. If this ID is in the GSIN format, it should be indicated in the attribute @schemeID.

Element.Name: Shipment description
Element.Description: Free-form text pertinent to this shipment, conveying information that is not contained explicitly in other structures.

Element.Name: Consignment information
Element.Description: The consignment, forming part of the shipment described by this Manifest, that this Manifest declares.

Element.Name: Consignment identifier
Element.Description: If this ID is in the GINC format, it should be indicated in the attribute @schemeID. This is the same consignment as declared on the referenced Waybill.

Element.Name: Consignee Consignment identifier
Element.Description: Consignment identifier assigned by the consignee

Element.Name: Consignor Consignment identifier
Element.Description: Consignment identifier assigned by the consignor

Element.Name: Consignment gross weight
Element.Description: The gross weight of the consignment as declared on the Manifest. Should match the gross weight declared on the referenced Waybill.

Element.Name: Consignment gross volume
Element.Description: The gross volume of the consignment as declared on the Manifest. Should match the gross volume declared on the referenced Waybill.

Element.Name: Total number of transport handling units
Element.Description: The total number of transport handling units in this consignment

Element.Name: Waybill reference
Element.Description: Reference to the Waybill that covers this consignment in full detail (parties, goods items, hazardous items, transport handling units etc.). This reference is mandatory for every Consignment declared in a Manifest under this profile: the Manifest itself is deliberately kept lean and relies on the Waybill for the complete data set.

Element.Name: Identity of the reference
Element.Description: The cbc:ID of the referenced Waybill.

Element.Name: Document type code
Element.Description: The type of reference. Must be part of UNCL1001. Use the transport-mode-specific code where known (e.g. 740 Air waybill, 710 Sea waybill, 703 House waybill), or the generic 700 Waybill otherwise.

Element.Name: Document type
Element.Description: The type of reference that cannot be specified by a code alone.

Element.Name: Additional document reference
Element.Description: Reference to other documents relevant for this Manifest as a whole (as opposed to a single consignment), for example a Master Air Waybill covering several house waybills/consignments consolidated on the same flight.

Element.Name: Identity of the reference
Element.Description: The reference number of the added document

Element.Name: Document type code
Element.Description: The type of reference. Must be part of UNCL1001.

Element.Name: Document type
Element.Description: The type of reference that cannot be specified by a code

Element.Name: Attachment
Element.Description: Group to describe an attached document. An attachment can refer to an external document or be included with the document being exchanged.

Element.Name: External reference
Element.Description: A reference to an attached document that is external to the document(s) being exchanged.

Element.Name: Address to internet resource
Element.Description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that identifies the external object as an Internet resource.

Element.Name: Document distribution
Element.Description: Describes the distribution of a copy of this Manifest to an interested party other than the Authority named in cac:AuthorityParty, e.g. the cargo terminal handling the shipment.

Element.Name: Identifier
Element.Description: An identifier for this document distribution.

Element.Name: Distribution type
Element.Description: The type of distribution, expressed as text.

Element.Name: Party
Element.Description: The interested party who receives a copy of this Manifest.

Element.Name: Party name
Element.Description: The name of the receiving party.

Element.Name: Postal address
Element.Description: The postal address of the receiving party.

Element.Name: City
Element.Description: The common name of the city where the postal address is.

Element.Name: Country
Element.Description: The country of the address

Element.Name: Country code
Element.Description: A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Element.Name: Contact
Element.Description: The contact of the receiving party.

Element.Name: Contact name
Element.Description: The contact name.

Element.Name: Contact email address
Element.Description: The electronic mail of the contact.

Element.Name: Signature
Element.Description: A signature applied to this Manifest, typically by the Authority to confirm receipt/acceptance, or by the Sending Logistics Operator to attest the declaration.

Element.Name: Identifier Signature
Element.Description: The Id of the Signature.
The date upon which this signature was verified. Format = "YYYY-MM-DD".
The local time at which this signature was verified. Format = "hh:mm:ss".

Element.Description: The party signing this Manifest.

Element.Description: The name of the Signature party.

Element.Name: Postal address
Element.Description: The postal address of the Signature Party

Element.Description: A code that identifies the country, according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Element.Description: The person who applies the signature on behalf of the Signature Party.
